blocks.title: Today’s Learning Roadmap
content: apply exponential and logarithmic models

blocks.title: Predict: apply exponential and logarithmic models
content: Which formula or inverse relationship would you choose first?
instructor_notes: Require an individual prediction before discussion.

blocks.title: apply exponential and logarithmic models
content: Match wording to compound-interest formulas.
$\log_b(x)=y\iff b^y=x$.

blocks.title: Model the Skill: apply exponential and logarithmic models
content: Find the balance for $2500$ at 5.2% compounded quarterly for 6 years, then convert $\log_2(32)=5$.
verification: Recalculate all Test 2 algebra review answers.
steps: The interest result uses dollars; the logarithmic conversion is dimensionless.

blocks.title: You Try: apply exponential and logarithmic models
content: Find the balance on $4000 at 6% monthly for 10 years and rewrite $\log_3(81)=4$.

blocks.title: Check and Diagnose: apply exponential and logarithmic models
content: Convert rates to decimals and preserve the logarithm base.
instructor_notes: Ask students to explain why the incorrect path fails.
verification: Recalculate all Test 2 algebra review answers.

blocks.title: Make It Stick: apply exponential and logarithmic models
content: Write the first decision you make in each problem type.
instructor_notes: If more than 3 minutes behind, shorten discussion but preserve the next practice and feedback slides.
blocks.pacing_checkpoint: Check elapsed time before beginning the next objective.

blocks.title: Predict: solve angle, arc, and sector problems
content: Which formulas require radians and which accept degrees after conversion?
instructor_notes: Require an individual prediction before discussion.

blocks.title: solve angle, arc, and sector problems
content: Convert angles before applying $s=r\theta$ or $A=\tfrac12r^2\theta$.
Use circle theorems only after identifying the intercepted arc.

blocks.title: Model the Skill: solve angle, arc, and sector problems
content: Convert $5\pi/6$ to degrees and find arc length for $r=9$, $\theta=2\pi/3$.
verification: Verify every angle and circle review result.
steps: Radians cancel in the arc-length calculation.

blocks.title: You Try: solve angle, arc, and sector problems
content: Find arc length for $r=12$, $\theta=40^\circ$.

blocks.title: Check and Diagnose: solve angle, arc, and sector problems
content: Do not mix degrees and radians.
Central and inscribed angles obey different rules.
instructor_notes: Ask students to explain why the incorrect path fails.
verification: Verify every angle and circle review result.

blocks.title: Make It Stick: solve angle, arc, and sector problems
content: State the unit check for an arc or sector answer.
instructor_notes: If more than 3 minutes behind, shorten discussion but preserve the next practice and feedback slides.
blocks.pacing_checkpoint: Check elapsed time before beginning the next objective.

blocks.title: Predict: choose area, similarity, and speed strategies
content: What information tells you to use Heron, trapezoid area, similarity, or $v=r\omega$?
instructor_notes: Require an individual prediction before discussion.

blocks.title: choose area, similarity, and speed strategies
content: Formula selection depends on the givens, not the picture’s appearance.
Write corresponding sides in consistent order.

blocks.title: Model the Skill: choose area, similarity, and speed strategies
content: Find a trapezoid area with bases 10 and 16 and height 7, then solve $6/9=x/15$.
steps: Formula choice follows the given measurements and correspondence.

blocks.title: You Try: choose area, similarity, and speed strategies
content: Solve $6/9=x/15$. Then find the rim speed of a wheel with radius 0.4 m turning at 5 rad/s.

blocks.title: Check and Diagnose: choose area, similarity, and speed strategies
content: Most lost points come from setup, units, or mismatched corresponding sides.
instructor_notes: Ask students to explain why the incorrect path fails.

blocks.title: Make It Stick: choose area, similarity, and speed strategies
content: Name the evidence that selects each geometry strategy.
instructor_notes: If more than 3 minutes behind, shorten discussion but preserve the next practice and feedback slides.

blocks.title: Session Summary and Exit Ticket
content: State the most important idea from today without looking at your notes.
Complete one representative setup and identify the step most likely to cause an error.
Write one question that should be answered before the next assessment.
answer: Use the objective roadmap to identify any skill that still needs deliberate practice.
